import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem normalCore_finset_inf_eq_inf_normalCore {G : Type*} [Group G] (S : Finset (Subgroup G)) :
  (S.inf (fun H => H)).normalCore = S.inf (fun H => H.normalCore) := by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simp
  | @insert H S hS ih =>
      rw [Finset.inf_insert, Finset.inf_insert]
      apply le_antisymm
      · refine le_inf ?_ ?_
        · exact Subgroup.normalCore_mono inf_le_left
        · exact le_trans (Subgroup.normalCore_mono inf_le_right) ih.le
      · have hS_normal : (S.inf (fun K => K.normalCore)).Normal := by
          rw [Finset.inf_eq_iInf]
          exact Subgroup.normal_iInf_normal (fun K =>
            Subgroup.normal_iInf_normal (fun hK : K ∈ S => K.normalCore_normal))
        letI : (H.normalCore ⊓ S.inf (fun K => K.normalCore)).Normal :=
          Subgroup.normal_inf_normal _ _
        apply Subgroup.normal_le_normalCore.mpr
        refine le_inf ?_ ?_
        · exact inf_le_left.trans (Subgroup.normalCore_le H)
        · refine le_trans inf_le_right ?_
          refine Finset.le_inf ?_
          intro K hK
          exact le_trans (Finset.inf_le hK) (Subgroup.normalCore_le K)
